cases.message: Low-level send_pane_input cannot write to agent pane. Use message_agent so communication policy, durable inbox, and deferred delivery are enforced.
Soyeht rejected the claimed agent identity because its SOYEHT_LAUNCH_NONCE was missing or did not belong to that pane.
Soyeht Dev rejected MCP client contract 1; agent creation and messaging require contract 2.
